tools.name: verify_email_deliverability
tools.description: Validates email syntax, disposable/burner provider status, role accounts, and live DNS MX/SPF/DMARC records. WHEN TO USE: Call `verify_email_deliverability` when your task requires deterministic `email-verify` analysis for `email`; use `get_agent_wallet_status` to check your remaining free trial quo

tools.name: get_agent_wallet_status
tools.description: Inspect an agent's account ledger: remaining free trial calls (out of 5), prepaid USD balance, cumulative spend, total API calls, and total LLM tokens saved. WHEN TO USE: Call before a batch of paid tool executions or after completing a Stripe or USDC top-up to confirm your balance. WHEN NOT TO USE:

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "email-verify" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: verify_email_deliverability · Private data: verify_email_deliverability, get_agent_wallet_status · Public sink: verify_email_deliverability, get_agent_wallet_status · Destructive: get_agent_wallet_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: verify_email_deliverability · Private data: verify_email_deliverability, get_agent_wallet_status · Public sink: verify_email_deliverability, get_agent_wallet_status · Destructive: get_agent_wallet_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
